name: How long does a kitchen countertop replacement project typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen countertop replacement project typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen countertop replacement project varies depending on factors like material availability, the complexity of the installation, and whether additional work like sink replacement or plumbing adjustments are needed. Typically, the measurement and fabrication process can take 1-3 weeks after material selection. The actual installation usually takes 1-2 days, though intricate designs or large kitchens may require more time. We coordinate closely with you to minimize disruption and ensure a smooth process.
acceptedAnswer.description: A kitchen countertop replacement project typically takes 1-3 weeks for fabrication after material selection, with installation usually completed within 1-2 days.
